column1: # VSCS alignment / Against demand. openings_asking_* counts only occupations whose entry credential is sub-baccalaureate, bachelor's or graduate -- the three VSCS awards into -- and is what the chart divides by. pct_of_all_openings is the measure it replaced. A group with fewer than 10 such openings has no base to divide by and is named under the chart instead of drawn as a zero. NOTE: graduates_attributed is modelled, not observed -- see the README.
